svg.title: AuraProj daily change reference for 2026-08-03
svg.desc: Enemy ability migration, damage context, and truthful smoke tests.
svg.text: 2026-08-03 - Enemy abilities and damage context
Daily job
Bring enemy abilities into the graph migration and carry damage provenance through execution.
Enemy XML/config/nodes, knockback direction, CauseDamage/ApplyDamage, projectile ASC, smoke paths, and migration audit changed.
BEFORE
Player-focused graph migration
Enemy abilities lacked graph definitions.
Damage provenance and knockback paths
were inconsistent.
Smoke could pass without real graph paths.
AFTER
Enemy graph path carries context
FireBolt, hit react, melee, and ranged enemy abilities get XML/config/native nodes.
Knockback uses target direction; CauseDamage and ApplyDamage align.
Damage context is populated and projectile ASC setup is explicit.
Smoke tests exercise real graph/module paths and migration audit records status.
Guard: a passing smoke test must traverse the production-shaped path.
Important guard
Damage source, target direction, context, and
execution must remain observable. Do not let
a stub make smoke appear green.
Validation / newcomer path
Read enemy XML/config and native nodes first.
Then follow damage context and the smoke/audit
documents for truthful execution evidence.
